question: Do additive-fibre component conditions force all mixed arithmetic ranks to vanish when the promoted anchor Kummer classes are distinct?
checks: S3 component-module invariants and the canonical kappa residue pattern
Exact odd-prime certificates distinguishing the three generic Kummer classes
Explicit chord square roots for P0+2P1 and P0+2P2, forming a same-class control
Universal identities D=gamma*kappa, norm(kappa)=D^2, additive-branch evaluations, and residue-algebra determinants
boundary: A necessary rational-section gate, not a sufficient solubility criterion or a production-fibre rank bound. Equal-class controls retain UNKNOWN section existence.
generic_rank_claim: Each nonempty product of rational linear characters has arithmetic rank at most one. Distinct required additive-fibre classes force rank zero. The full base change for pairwise distinct point classes has only its singleton arithmetic ranks, plus the original rank.
